BatchDeleteModels.description_en: Deletes models in a specified workspace in batches. If any model is in use, the entire batch request fails
BatchDeleteModels.description_zh: 批量删除指定工作空间中的模型；任一模型正在被使用时，整批请求失败

BatchUploadSkillsViaOss.description_en: Uploads Skill ZIP packages in bulk through OSS and returns the processing result of each Skill
BatchUploadSkillsViaOss.description_zh: 通过 OSS 中转批量上传 Skill ZIP 包，并返回每个 Skill 的处理结果

CreateAgentIMChannel.description_en: Creates an IM channel for a specified agent and binds a publicly accessible ServiceEndpoint
CreateAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 为指定智能体创建 IM 渠道，并绑定可公开访问的 ServiceEndpoint

CreateAgentSpec.description_en: Creates an AgentSpec in the specified workspace and generates the first draft version. Returns a resource conflict error if an AgentSpec with the same name already exists
CreateAgentSpec.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建 AgentSpec，并生成首个草稿版本。同名 AgentSpec 已存在时返回资源冲突错误

CreateAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Creates a new draft version for an existing AgentSpec. The AgentSpec must exist, and there must not be a draft currently being edited
CreateAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 为已有 AgentSpec 创建新的草稿版本。AgentSpec 必须存在，且当前不能有正在编辑的草稿

CreateCredential.description_en: Creates a credential in a specified workspace for agent authentication when accessing external services. Currently, only the apiKey type is supported. The credential content is passed in as a JSON string through credentialMetadata and can only be queried in masked form after being written
CreateCredential.description_zh: 在指定工作空间内创建凭证，用于智能体访问外部服务时的鉴权。当前仅支持 apiKey 类型，凭证内容通过 credentialMetadata 以 JSON 字符串传入，写入后只能以脱敏形式查询

CreateExternalAgent.description_en: Creates an external agent in a specified workspace
CreateExternalAgent.description_zh: 在指定工作空间下创建外部智能体

CreateExternalAgentBootstrapToken.description_en: Creates a Bootstrap Token and CMS configuration required for connecting a specified external agent
CreateExternalAgentBootstrapToken.description_zh: 为指定外部智能体创建接入所需的 Bootstrap Token 和 CMS 配置

CreateIdentityProvider.description_en: Binds an external identity provider to a specified workspace for single sign-on and organization member synchronization. Each workspace can be bound to at most one external identity provider. The binding is an asynchronous operation. After the API returns, you can track the progress by querying the status through GetIdentityProvider
CreateIdentityProvider.description_zh: 为指定工作空间绑定外部身份提供商，用于工作空间用户的单点登录和组织成员同步。每个工作空间最多绑定一个外部身份提供商。绑定为异步操作，接口返回后可通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询 status 跟踪进展

CreateManagedAgent.description_en: Creates a managed agent in a specified workspace
CreateManagedAgent.description_zh: 在指定工作空间下创建托管智能体

CreateMcp.description_en: Creates an MCP service in a specified workspace. The creation is an asynchronous process. You can check whether the service is ready by using the returned status or by calling a query operation
CreateMcp.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建 MCP 服务。创建为异步过程，可通过返回的状态或查询接口确认服务是否就绪

CreateModel.description_en: Creates a model configuration under a specified model connection in a workspace
CreateModel.description_zh: 在指定工作空间的模型连接下创建模型配置

CreateModelConnection.description_en: Creates a model connection in a specified workspace and configures the upstream model service address, invoke protocol, and access credentials
CreateModelConnection.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建模型连接，并配置上游模型服务地址、调用协议和访问凭据

CreateSkillDraft.description_en: Creates a Skill in the specified workspace and generates a draft version that can be further edited. You can derive a draft from an existing version or specify a target version and commit message
CreateSkillDraft.description_zh: 在指定工作空间中创建 Skill，并生成可继续编辑的草稿版本。可以基于已有版本派生草稿，也可以指定目标版本和提交说明

CreateTeam.description_en: Creates a team in a specified workspace and sets user members and agent members at the same time. The user members must include exactly one member with the ADMIN role. Agent members can only have the LEADER or WORKER role
CreateTeam.description_zh: 在指定工作空间内创建团队，并同时设置用户成员和智能体成员。用户成员中必须且只能有一个角色为 ADMIN 的成员，智能体成员的角色只能是 LEADER 或 WORKER

CreateUser.description_en: Creates a user in a specified workspace. The username must be unique within the workspace and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Reserved names such as manager, admin, or names starting with worker- cannot be used. If password is not specified, the server generates an initial password and returns it in the initialPassword field of the response
CreateUser.description_zh: 在指定工作空间内创建用户。用户名称在工作空间内唯一，只能包含小写字母、数字和连字符，并且不能使用 manager、admin 或以 worker- 开头的保留名称。不指定 password 时由服务端生成初始密码，并通过响应中的 initialPassword 返回

CreateWorkspace.description_en: Creates an AgentCore workspace control plane record. The server completes the state transition from Initializing to Initialized within the same transaction
CreateWorkspace.description_zh: 创建 AgentCore 工作空间控制面记录。服务端在同一事务内完成 Initializing 到 Initialized 的状态转换

DebugModel.description_en: Calls a specified model through a published model connection to verify whether the model call chain is available
DebugModel.description_zh: 通过已发布的模型连接调用指定模型，用于验证模型调用链路是否可用

DeleteAgentIMChannel.description_en: Deletes an IM channel of a specified agent
DeleteAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 删除指定智能体的 IM 渠道

DeleteAgentSpec.description_en: Deletes a specified AgentSpec along with all its versions and metadata. This operation is irreversible
DeleteAgentSpec.description_zh: 删除指定 AgentSpec 及其全部版本和元数据。删除操作不可恢复

DeleteAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Deletes the draft version currently being edited for a specified AgentSpec and clears the draft version pointer
DeleteAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 删除指定 AgentSpec 当前正在编辑的草稿版本，并清除草稿版本指针

DeleteCredential.description_en: Deletes a credential from the specified workspace and removes the ciphertext hosted in the credential service. After deletion, agents that are bound to this credential can no longer retrieve the credential content
DeleteCredential.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间内的凭证，同时删除托管在凭证服务中的密文。删除后已绑定该凭证的智能体将无法再获取凭证内容

DeleteExternalAgent.description_zh: 删除指定的外部智能体

DeleteIdentityProvider.description_en: Unbinds the external identity provider from a specified workspace and cleans up users synchronized by that identity provider. The unbinding is an asynchronous operation. After the API returns, you can track the progress by querying the status through GetIdentityProvider
DeleteIdentityProvider.description_zh: 解绑指定工作空间的外部身份提供商，并清理由该身份提供商同步产生的用户。解绑为异步操作，接口返回后可通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询 status 跟踪进展

DeleteManagedAgent.description_zh: 删除指定的托管智能体

DeleteMcp.description_en: Deletes a specified MCP service. The deletion is an asynchronous process. After the deletion is complete, the MCP service is no longer returned
DeleteMcp.description_zh: 删除指定 MCP 服务。删除为异步过程，完成后该 MCP 服务将不再返回

DeleteModel.description_en: Deletes a model from a specified workspace. Models that are currently in use cannot be deleted
DeleteModel.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的模型；正在被使用的模型不能删除

DeleteModelConnection.description_en: Submits an asynchronous deletion task for a specified model connection. The connection cannot be deleted if it has associated models or runtime references
DeleteModelConnection.description_zh: 提交指定模型连接的异步删除任务；存在关联模型或运行时引用时不能删除

DeleteSkill.description_en: Deletes a skill and its related version data from a specified workspace. This operation is irreversible
DeleteSkill.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的 Skill 及其相关版本数据。删除操作不可恢复

DeleteSkillDraft.description_en: Deletes the draft version currently being edited for a specified Skill
DeleteSkillDraft.description_zh: 删除指定 Skill 当前正在编辑的草稿版本

DeleteTeam.description_en: Deletes a team in the specified workspace. Deleting a team does not delete the users or agents in the team. It only dissociates the member relationships
DeleteTeam.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间内的团队。删除团队不会删除其中的用户和智能体，只解除成员关系

DeleteUser.description_en: Deletes a user from a specified workspace. A user cannot be deleted while the user is still a member of any team. Remove the user from all teams before deleting the user
DeleteUser.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间内的用户。用户仍然是任意团队的成员时不允许删除，需要先将其从团队中移除

DeleteWorkspace.description_en: Deletes the control plane record of a specified workspace. The server completes the state transition from Deleting to Deleted within the same transaction. When you repeatedly delete a workspace that is in the Deleting or Deleted state, the server handles the request with idempotence semantics
DeleteWorkspace.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间控制面记录。服务端在同一事务内完成 Deleting 到 Deleted 的状态转换。重复删除处于 Deleting 或 Deleted 状态的工作空间时，服务端按幂等语义处理

DownloadAgentSpecViaOss.description_en: Retrieves a pre-signed OSS download URL for a specified AgentSpec ZIP package
DownloadAgentSpecViaOss.description_zh: 获取指定 AgentSpec 的 OSS 预签名下载地址，用于下载 AgentSpec ZIP 包

DownloadSkillVersionViaOss.description_en: Retrieves a pre-signed OSS download URL for a specified Skill version, which is used to download the corresponding Skill ZIP package
DownloadSkillVersionViaOss.description_zh: 获取指定 Skill 版本的 OSS 预签名下载地址，用于下载对应的 Skill ZIP 包

ForcePublishSkillVersion.description_en: Skips the regular review process and forcibly publishes the specified Skill version
ForcePublishSkillVersion.description_zh: 跳过常规审核流程，强制发布指定的 Skill 版本

GetAgentIMChannel.description_en: Queries the details of a specified agent IM channel
GetAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 查询指定智能体 IM 渠道的详细信息

GetAgentSpec.description_en: Queries the governance details of a specified AgentSpec, including basic information, governance pointers, and summaries of all versions
GetAgentSpec.description_zh: 查询指定 AgentSpec 的治理详情，包括基础信息、治理指针和全部版本摘要

GetAgentSpecImportFileUrl.description_en: Retrieves the OSS pre-signed upload URL and object name required for importing an AgentSpec ZIP package. After the upload is complete, call the AgentSpec OSS upload operation to complete the import
GetAgentSpecImportFileUrl.description_zh: 获取导入 AgentSpec ZIP 包所需的 OSS 预签名上传地址和对象名称。上传完成后，可调用 AgentSpec OSS 上传接口完成导入

GetAgentSpecLatest.description_en: Queries the full content of the latest version of a specified AgentSpec for editing or viewing
GetAgentSpecLatest.description_zh: 查询指定 AgentSpec 的最新版本完整内容，用于编辑或查看 latest 版本

GetAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Queries the complete content of a specified AgentSpec version, including manifest content, resource files, and metadata
GetAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 查询指定 AgentSpec 版本的完整内容，包括 manifest 内容、资源文件和元数据

GetCredential.description_en: Queries the details of a specified credential and returns the list of agents that are bound to the credential. The credential content is returned in masked form
GetCredential.description_zh: 查询指定凭证的详细信息，并返回已绑定该凭证的智能体列表。凭证内容以脱敏形式返回

GetExternalAgent.description_en: Queries the details of a specified external agent
GetExternalAgent.description_zh: 查询指定外部智能体的详细信息

GetExternalAgentBootstrapOptions.description_en: Queries the available network types for a specified external agent
GetExternalAgentBootstrapOptions.description_zh: 查询指定外部智能体可用的接入网络类型

GetIdentityProvider.description_en: Queries the binding details of an external identity provider for a specified workspace, including the binding status, application configuration, and callback URLs that need to be configured on the identity provider side. Application secret configurations are not returned
GetIdentityProvider.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间的外部身份提供商绑定详情，包括绑定状态、应用配置以及需要在身份提供商侧配置的回调地址。应用密钥类配置不会返回

GetManagedAgent.description_en: Queries the details of a specified managed agent
GetManagedAgent.description_zh: 查询指定托管智能体的详细信息

GetMcp.description_en: Queries the details of a specified MCP service, including its address, type, status, authentication configuration, and protocol
GetMcp.description_zh: 查询指定 MCP 服务的地址、类型、状态、认证配置和协议等详情

GetModel.description_en: Queries the detailed configuration and region of a model in a specified workspace
GetModel.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间中模型的详细配置和所属地域

GetModelConnection.description_en: Queries the detailed configuration, credential configuration status, publish status, and region of a specified model connection
GetModelConnection.description_zh: 查询指定模型连接的详细配置、凭据配置状态、发布状态和所属地域

GetServiceEndpoint.description_en: Queries the details of a specified service endpoint, including target routing, access URLs, authentication configuration, and current status
GetServiceEndpoint.description_zh: 查询指定服务端点的详细信息，包括目标路由、访问地址、鉴权配置和当前状态

GetServiceEndpointApiKey.description_en: Queries the currently active API Key and its invocation method for a specified service endpoint within a workspace
GetServiceEndpointApiKey.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间内服务端点当前生效的 API Key 及其调用方式

GetSkillDetail.description_en: Queries the basic information, version status, labels, visibility scope, and version list of a specified Skill
GetSkillDetail.description_zh: 查询指定 Skill 的基础信息、版本状态、标签、可见范围和版本列表

GetSkillImportFileUrl.description_en: Retrieves the OSS pre-signed upload URL and object name required for importing a Skill ZIP package. After the upload is complete, call the Skill OSS upload operation to complete the import
GetSkillImportFileUrl.description_zh: 获取导入 Skill ZIP 包所需的 OSS 预签名上传地址和对象名称。上传完成后，可调用 Skill OSS 上传接口完成导入

GetSkillVersionDetail.description_en: Queries the complete details of a specified Skill version, including version metadata, Skill content, and associated resources
GetSkillVersionDetail.description_zh: 查询指定 Skill 版本的完整详情，包括版本元数据、Skill 内容和关联资源

GetTeam.description_en: Queries the details of a specified team. The response includes the complete properties and team roles of each user member and agent member in the team
GetTeam.description_zh: 查询指定团队的详细信息，响应中同时返回团队内每个用户成员和智能体成员的完整属性及其团队角色

GetUser.description_en: Queries the details of a specified user in a workspace. Returns an error if the user does not exist
GetUser.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间内某个用户的详细信息。用户不存在时返回错误

GetWorkspace.description_en: Queries workspace details by workspace ID, including lifecycle status, CMS Workspace, AIRegistry Namespace, and current network policy
GetWorkspace.description_zh: 根据工作空间 ID 查询工作空间详情，包括生命周期状态、CMS Workspace、AIRegistry Namespace 和当前网络策略

GetWorkspacePlugin.description_en: Queries the plug-in status of a specified workspace
GetWorkspacePlugin.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间的插件状态

InstallWorkspacePlugin.description_en: Installs a plugin for a specified AgentCore workspace. Currently supports the collaboration plugin. The installation process is executed asynchronously
InstallWorkspacePlugin.description_zh: 为指定的 AgentCore 工作空间安装插件。当前支持 collaboration 插件，安装过程异步执行

ListAgentIMChannels.description_en: Queries the IM channel list of a specified agent
ListAgentIMChannels.description_zh: 查询指定智能体的 IM 渠道列表

ListAgentSpecs.description_en: Queries AgentSpec resources in a specified workspace by using paging, supporting name search, sorting, and filtering by owner, visibility scope, and business labels
ListAgentSpecs.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 AgentSpec，支持名称搜索、排序以及按所有者、可见范围和业务标签筛选

ListAgentTeams.description_en: Queries the list of teams to which specified agents belong. Specify the agent IDs through agentIds to retrieve the membership information between each agent and its teams, including the team ID, team name, and the role that the agent assumes in the team
ListAgentTeams.description_zh: 查询指定智能体所属的团队列表。通过 agentIds 指定需要查询的智能体 ID，返回每个智能体与团队的成员关系信息，包括团队 ID、团队名称和智能体在团队中承担的角色

ListCredentials.description_en: Queries credentials in a specified workspace by paging. You can use credentialType to filter by type, nameLike to filter by credential name using fuzzy match, maxResults to specify the maximum number of records per page, and nextToken to retrieve the next page. If maxResults is not specified, the server returns 10 records by default
ListCredentials.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的凭证。通过 credentialType 按类型过滤，通过 nameLike 按凭证名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条

ListExternalAgents.description_en: Queries the list of external agents in a specified workspace
ListExternalAgents.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间下的外部智能体列表

ListIdentityProviders.description_en: Queries the external identity provider bound to a specified workspace. Each workspace can be bound to at most one external identity provider, so the response returns at most one record. Application secret configurations are not returned
ListIdentityProviders.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间已绑定的外部身份提供商。每个工作空间最多绑定一个外部身份提供商，因此响应最多返回一条记录。应用密钥类配置不会返回

ListManagedAgents.description_en: Queries the list of managed agents in a specified workspace
ListManagedAgents.description_zh: 查询指定工作空间下的托管智能体列表

ListMcpTools.description_en: Queries the list of tools exposed by a specified MCP service and their input/output schemas
ListMcpTools.description_zh: 查询指定 MCP 服务公开的工具列表及其输入输出 Schema

ListMcps.description_en: Queries MCP services and their configurations and statuses in a specified workspace by page
ListMcps.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 MCP 服务及其配置和状态

ListModelConnections.description_en: Queries model connections in a specified workspace with paging. Supports filtering by name, provider type, and invoke protocol
ListModelConnections.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的模型连接，支持按名称、供应商类型和调用协议筛选

ListModels.description_en: Queries models in a specified workspace by using paging. Supports filtering by model connection and model name
ListModels.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的模型，支持按模型连接和模型名称筛选

ListPredefinedModelProviders.description_en: 查询预定义模型供应商目录
ListPredefinedModelProviders.description_zh: 查询预定义模型供应商目录

ListPredefinedModels.description_en: Queries the models and their capability information for a specified provider in the AgentCore built-in model catalog
ListPredefinedModels.description_zh: 查询指定供应商在 AgentCore 内置模型目录中的模型及其能力信息

ListServiceEndpoints.description_en: Queries service endpoints in a specified workspace by using paging. Supports filtering by target type, agent, collaboration component, and status
ListServiceEndpoints.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的服务端点，支持按目标类型、智能体、协作组件和状态过滤

ListSkills.description_en: Performs a paged query of Skills in a specified workspace, and returns basic Skill information, version status, and paging details
ListSkills.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 Skill，返回 Skill 基础信息、版本状态和分页信息

ListTeams.description_en: Queries teams in a specified workspace by paging. Use nameLike to filter by team name with fuzzy match, maxResults to specify the maximum number of records per page, and nextToken to retrieve the next page. If maxResults is not specified, the server returns 10 records by default. Member information in the list includes only the member identity, name, and team role
ListTeams.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的团队。通过 nameLike 按团队名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条。列表中的成员信息只包含成员标识、名称和团队角色

ListUsers.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的用户。通过 nameLike 按用户名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条

ListWorkspaces.description_en: Queries workspaces under the current tenant with paging. The list does not return soft-deleted records with a status of Deleted by default. Results are stably sorted by creation order on the server side
ListWorkspaces.description_zh: 分页查询当前租户下的工作空间。列表默认不返回状态为 Deleted 的软删除记录，结果按创建顺序由服务端稳定排序

OfflineSkill.description_en: Takes the online version of a specified Skill offline so that it is no longer used as the online version
OfflineSkill.description_zh: 将指定 Skill 的在线版本下线，使其不再作为在线版本使用

OnlineSkill.description_en: Sets a specified Skill version as the online version
OnlineSkill.description_zh: 将指定 Skill 版本设置为在线版本

PrecheckSkillUploadViaOss.description_en: Parses and checks one or more Skill ZIP packages uploaded to OSS, and returns the name, version, and conflict check results
PrecheckSkillUploadViaOss.description_zh: 解析并检查已上传到 OSS 的一个或多个 Skill ZIP 包，返回名称、版本和冲突检查结果

PublishSkillVersion.description_en: Publishes a specified Skill version to change its state to published
PublishSkillVersion.description_zh: 发布指定的 Skill 版本，使其进入已发布状态

RedraftSkillVersion.description_en: Converts a specified Skill version back into an editable draft for further modifications
RedraftSkillVersion.description_zh: 将指定 Skill 版本重新转为可编辑草稿，以便继续修改

ResetUserPassword.description_en: Resets the logon password of a specified user. Specify the user by agentCoreUserId or username. At least one of the two parameters must be specified. Only users who use workspace local password authentication can be reset. If password is not specified, the server generates a random password and returns it in the response
ResetUserPassword.description_zh: 重置指定用户的登录密码。通过 agentCoreUserId 或 username 指定用户，两者至少指定一个。仅支持重置使用工作空间本地密码认证的用户；不指定 password 时由服务端生成随机密码并在响应中返回

SubmitAgentSpecVersion.description_en: Submits a specified AgentSpec draft version for review. If no release pipeline is configured, the version is published directly to online status
SubmitAgentSpecVersion.description_zh: 提交指定 AgentSpec 草稿版本进入审核流程。未配置发布流水线时，版本将直接发布为在线状态

SubmitSkillVersion.description_en: Submits a specified draft version of a skill for review
SubmitSkillVersion.description_zh: 提交指定的 Skill 草稿版本进入审核流程

UpdateAgentIMChannel.description_en: Updates the ServiceEndpoint binding, enabled/disabled status, or channel behavior configuration of an IM channel. At least one updatable field must be provided
UpdateAgentIMChannel.description_zh: 更新 IM 渠道绑定的 ServiceEndpoint、启停状态或渠道行为配置。至少需要提供一个可更新字段

UpdateAgentIMChannelCredential.description_en: Performs a full update of the channel credential for a specified IM channel of an agent. Secrets are not returned in the response
UpdateAgentIMChannelCredential.description_zh: 全量更新指定 IM 渠道的渠道凭据。Secret 不会在响应中回显

UpdateAgentSpec.description_en: Updates the business tags, version labels, and visibility scope of a specified AgentSpec. Fields that are not provided remain unchanged
UpdateAgentSpec.description_zh: 更新指定 AgentSpec 的业务标签、版本标签和可见范围；未传入的字段保持不变

UpdateCredential.description_en: Updates the content or description of a specified credential. At least one of credentialMetadata and description must be specified. Unspecified properties remain unchanged. The credential name and credential type cannot be modified after creation
UpdateCredential.description_zh: 更新指定凭证的凭证内容或描述。credentialMetadata 和 description 至少指定一个，未指定的属性保持不变。凭证名称和凭证类型创建后不可修改

UpdateExternalAgent.description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified external agent
UpdateExternalAgent.description_zh: 更新指定外部智能体的配置

UpdateIdentityProvider.description_en: Updates the login switch, member synchronization switch, or application configuration of a specified external identity provider in a workspace. Unspecified properties remain unchanged. The update is an asynchronous operation. After the API returns, you can call GetIdentityProvider to query the status and track progress
UpdateIdentityProvider.description_zh: 更新指定工作空间外部身份提供商的登录开关、成员同步开关或应用配置。未指定的属性保持不变。更新为异步操作，接口返回后可通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询 status 跟踪进展

UpdateManagedAgent.description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified managed agent
UpdateManagedAgent.description_zh: 更新指定托管智能体的配置

UpdateMcp.description_en: Updates the address, description, authentication, or Swagger configuration of a specified MCP service. The MCP type and protocol cannot be modified after creation. The update is an asynchronous process
UpdateMcp.description_zh: 更新指定 MCP 服务的地址、描述、认证或 Swagger 配置。MCP 类型和协议在创建后不可修改。更新为异步过程

UpdateModel.description_en: Updates the description of a specified model. Other model configurations cannot be modified through this operation
UpdateModel.description_zh: 更新指定模型的描述；模型的其他配置不可通过该接口修改

UpdateModelConnection.description_en: Updates the mutable configuration of a specified model connection and resubmits the publish task. The protocol cannot be modified after the model connection is created
UpdateModelConnection.description_zh: 更新指定模型连接的可变配置并重新提交发布任务；调用协议创建后不可修改

UpdateSkillBizTags.description_en: Updates the business tags of a specified Skill. Other attributes that are not included in the request remain unchanged
UpdateSkillBizTags.description_zh: 更新指定 Skill 的业务标签；未传入的其他属性保持不变

UpdateSkillLabels.description_en: Updates the version labels and their mappings for a specified Skill
UpdateSkillLabels.description_zh: 更新指定 Skill 的版本标签及其指向关系

UpdateSkillScope.description_en: Updates the visibility scope of a specified skill
UpdateSkillScope.description_zh: 更新指定 Skill 的可见范围

UpdateTeam.description_en: Updates the description and members of a specified team. When users or agents are passed in, the corresponding member list is replaced using full overwrite semantics. Member lists that are not passed in remain unchanged. The team name cannot be modified after creation
UpdateTeam.description_zh: 更新指定团队的描述和成员。传入 users 或 agents 时按全量覆盖语义替换对应的成员列表，未传入的成员列表保持不变。团队名称创建后不可修改

UpdateUser.description_en: Updates the display name, email address, or note of a specified user. At least one of displayName, email, and note must be specified. Unspecified properties remain unchanged. The username cannot be modified after creation
UpdateUser.description_zh: 更新指定用户的显示名称、邮箱或备注。displayName、email 和 note 至少指定一个，未指定的属性保持不变。用户名称创建后不可修改

UpdateWorkspace.description_en: Updates the name or network configuration of a workspace. Only workspaces in the Initialized status can be updated. Status, TenantId, and RegionId are maintained by the server and cannot be modified through this operation
UpdateWorkspace.description_zh: 更新工作空间名称或网络配置。只有状态为 Initialized 的工作空间允许更新。Status、TenantId 和 RegionId 由服务端维护，不允许通过本接口修改

UploadAgentSpecViaOss.description_en: Retrieves an uploaded AgentSpec ZIP package from OSS, parses it, and imports the AgentSpec into the current workspace
UploadAgentSpecViaOss.description_zh: 从 OSS 获取已上传的 AgentSpec ZIP 包，解析后将 AgentSpec 导入当前工作空间

UploadSkillViaOss.description_en: Retrieves an uploaded Skill ZIP package from OSS, parses it, and imports the Skill into the current workspace
UploadSkillViaOss.description_zh: 从 OSS 获取已上传的 Skill ZIP 包，解析后将 Skill 导入当前工作空间
